disambiguation: Not just a highlighter; it provides floating selection tools, block actions, and side comments.
intentEvidence: It brings a Feishu / Lark Docs-like workflow to local notes, with optional comment synchronization to Feishu / Lark.
problem: Users lack a streamlined, visual annotation and commenting workflow similar to modern collaborative document tools like Feishu or Lark within local Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: optional comment synchronization to Feishu / Lark.

summary: FloatMark adds Feishu/Lark-style floating selection tools, inline highlights, and side comments to Obsidian notes, bringing a collaborative document workflow to local Markdown.
